subject.title: fix(agents): add tool-use terminal continuation for codex app-server toolUse stops

question: Should post-side-effect terminal continuation be accepted only when the harness can enforce a tool-disabled follow-up and prove all native tool items completed?
rationale: The branch crosses the existing replay and side-effect boundary, while a normal internal prompt does not establish that another tool invocation is impossible.

options.title: Require enforced no-tools continuation
options.body: Block merge until the Codex harness provides completed-item validation and a runtime-enforced tool-disabled follow-up.

options.title: Accept prompt-only mitigation
options.body: Land the generic retry while accepting that the model can still invoke tools after previous side effects.

options.title: Pause for upstream support
options.body: Defer this workaround and track a stronger upstream Codex terminal-turn continuation contract.

recommendation.title: Require enforced no-tools continuation
recommendation.body: Block merge until the Codex harness provides completed-item validation and a runtime-enforced tool-disabled follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work connects this person to the Codex app-server lifecycle and the embedded-runner recovery boundary.
